# The Last Light

Every evening, old Marcus climbed the hill behind his house to watch the sunset.

His neighbors thought it was a strange habit. "Don't you have things to do?" they'd ask.

"This *is* something to do," he'd answer.

One evening, a small girl from down the road followed him. She sat beside him in the grass without asking permission and watched the sky turn orange, then pink, then deep purple.

When the last light faded, she finally spoke.

"Do you ever get tired of watching the same sunset?"

Marcus smiled. "I've been coming here for forty years," he said, "and I've never seen the same one twice."
